title: Concept art to a game-ready pack
pitch: Three drawings in. Three textured meshes at real scale, a turntable of each and a Godot pack out.
why: Krea 2 sets the art direction, TRELLIS.2 turns each drawing into a textured mesh, and World Kit's Blender step does the dull part that makes a mesh usable: real size, pivot, collider, and a pack an engine can open.

models.name: Krea 2
models.note: Read the terms before commercial use.

models.name: Blender
models.licence: GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Plain background, whole object, one object: that is what the mesh model reads best.

steps.label: Art: lantern
steps.does: The drawing the 3D model is built from.
steps.prompt: Stylised game prop concept art of an old brass ship's lantern with thick green glass and a ring handle, a single object, the whole object in view, centred, three-quarter view, hand-painted texture, plain light grey studio background, soft even light. No text, no logos.

steps.label: Mesh: lantern
steps.does: Cuts the object out and builds a textured mesh from the one picture.

steps.label: Asset: lantern
steps.does: Real-world size, pivot at the base, a box collider and a turntable.
